testName: NPSP: Donation Split with General Accounting Unit (GAU) Allocations
steps:
1. Open Donations (Opportunities) tab
2. Click on New button
3. Select Record Type "Donation"
4. Enter Opportunity Name "Rockefeller Annual Endowment Grant"
5. Select Account "The Rockefeller Foundation"
6. Enter Amount "$100,000" and Stage "Closed Won"
7. Click on Save button
8. Scroll to GAU Allocations related list and click "Manage Allocations"
9. Allocate 70% ($70,000) to General Accounting Unit "Youth STEM Scholarship Fund"
10. Allocate 30% ($30,000) to General Accounting Unit "Campus Building Fund"
11. Click on Save button
12. Verify Total Allocated equals 100% and unallocated amount equals $0.00
